summary: Seattle, software engineer, strong interest in Linux and open-source software, experience with web development and system administration, enjoys electronic music (especially Aphex Twin and Autechre), critical of software patents and corporate practices, advocates for security best practices in technology, has a background in programming languages (including Perl and Go), has experience with various Linux distributions (including Arch and FreeBSD), has a history of working with databases and server management, engaged in discussions about technology ethics and user privacy, has a critical view of mainstream media and corporate influence, has a personal interest in DIY tech projects (like building a custom car stereo), and has a strong opinion on the importance of usability in software design.
